74|fn build_race_strategy_window(context: &TrainingContext) -> Vec<CompactRaceStrategyWindow<'_>> {
75|    if context.races.is_empty() {
76|        return Vec::new();
77|    }
78|
79|    let Some(focus_date) = infer_packed_focus_date(context) else {
80|        return Vec::new();
81|    };
82|    let window_end = focus_date + Duration::days(RACE_STRATEGY_WINDOW_DAYS);
83|    let mut entries = context
84|        .races
85|        .iter()
86|        .filter_map(|race| compact_race_strategy_window_entry(race, focus_date, window_end))
87|        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
88|    entries.sort_by(|left, right| left.d.cmp(right.d));
89|    entries
90|}

92|fn compact_race_strategy_window_entry<'a>(
93|    race: &'a RaceContext,
94|    focus_date: NaiveDate,
95|    window_end: NaiveDate,
96|) -> Option<CompactRaceStrategyWindow<'a>> {
97|    let race_date = NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&race.date, "%Y-%m-%d").ok()?;
98|    if race_date < focus_date || race_date > window_end {
99|        return None;
100|    }
101|
102|    Some(CompactRaceStrategyWindow {
103|        d: &race.date,
104|        pri: &race.priority,
105|        disc: &race.discipline,
106|        n: &race.name,
107|        days_out: (race_date - focus_date).num_days() as i32,
108|    })

111|fn infer_packed_focus_date(context: &TrainingContext) -> Option<NaiveDate> {
112|    if let Some(latest_recent_day) = context
113|        .recent_days
114|        .iter()
115|        .filter_map(|day| NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&day.date, "%Y-%m-%d").ok())
116|        .max()
117|    {
118|        return Some(latest_recent_day);
119|    }
120|
121|    if let Some(earliest_upcoming_day) = context
122|        .upcoming_days
123|        .iter()
124|        .filter_map(|day| NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&day.date, "%Y-%m-%d").ok())
125|        .min()
126|    {
127|        return earliest_upcoming_day.pred_opt();
128|    }
129|
